title: FACTORY: A Challenging Human-Verified Prompt Set for Long-Form Factuality
authors_zh: Mingda Chen, Yang Li, Xilun Chen, Adina Williams, Gargi Ghosh, Scott Yih
paper_type_zh: 人工核验的长文本事实性提示与证据评测集
best_for_zh: 需要构建或审计长文本事实性 Judge、证据检索和 claim 级评测的研究者。
one_line: FACTORY pairs difficult human-refined long-form prompts with claim-level evidence annotations.
FACTORY 将人工修订的困难长文本提示与 claim 级证据标注配对，用于可靠评估模型事实性。
why: It separates model factuality failures from defects in automatically generated prompts.
inclusion_reason: FACTORY supplies human-verified prompts and claim-level evidence for long-form factuality assessment.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-form factuality benchmarks often begin with automatically generated prompts that can be ambiguous, unanswerable, or too easy, while automatic judges may treat claims with unavailable evidence as false. Without human verification, benchmark defects become confounded with model hallucination and long-tail, multi-source synthesis is under-tested.

FACTORY uses a model-in-the-loop process to expand Wikipedia topics and filter difficult prompts, followed by human refinement. It also releases claim-level factuality labels, evidence URLs, and snippets for evaluated model responses.

长文本事实性评测常从自动生成问题出发，提示可能含糊、不可回答或过于简单；自动事实 Judge 又可能把无法找到证据的 claim 误判为错误。缺少人工验证会使 benchmark 的质量问题与模型幻觉混在一起，并难以测试长尾事实和跨来源综合。

FACTORY 使用 model-in-the-loop 从 Wikipedia 主题扩展并筛选困难提示，再由人工修订问题；作者同时公开模型回答的 claim 级事实标签、证据 URL 和片段。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: FACTORY is a large, human-verified English long-form prompt set released in JSONL with all, hard, and fact_checking splits, in the 10K–100K size range. Prompt records contain questions and relevant URLs. Human fact-checking decomposes responses into claims labelled Factual, NonFactual, Inconclusive, or No Verifiable Fact and preserves evidence sources and snippets. The contribution includes difficult, answerable, non-time-sensitive prompts and claim–label–evidence objects for training or auditing factuality judges.

FACTORY 是大规模、人类验证的英文长文提示集，官方数据页以 JSONL 发布 all、hard 和 fact_checking splits，规模处于 10K–100K。每个提示记录问题和相关 URL；人工事实标注将回答拆成 claims，并标 Factual、NonFactual、Inconclusive 或 No Verifiable Fact，同时保存证据来源与引用片段。核心贡献既包括高难、可回答、非时效敏感的提示，也包括可训练 factuality Judge 的 claim—标签—证据对象。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select seed topics: Broad Wikipedia topics are sampled to avoid covering only common encyclopaedic questions.
  1. Expand and filter with models: LLMs turn topics into diverse long-form questions, and model-in-the-loop filtering removes prompts that current systems answer too easily to create hard candidates.
  1. Human-refine prompts: Annotators ensure questions are fact-seeking, answerable, unambiguous, non-time-sensitive, and safe, deleting or rewriting defects.
  1. Annotate claims: Responses from six retrieval-augmented models are decomposed into claims. Humans search for evidence and assign four labels with URLs and snippets. Reproduction requires fixed search dates and evidence availability.

1. 选择种子主题： 从 Wikipedia 获取广泛主题，避免只覆盖常见百科问题。
  1. 模型扩展与筛难： LLM 将主题扩写为多样长文问题，再用 model-in-the-loop 过滤当前模型容易回答的提示，形成 hard 候选。
  1. 人工修订提示： 标注者检查问题是否求事实、可回答、无歧义、非时效敏感且安全，删除或改写缺陷样本。
  1. claim 级事实标注： 对六个检索增强模型的回答抽取 claims，人工查找证据并标四类标签、URL 和 snippet。复现需固定搜索时间与证据可得性。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors human-evaluate responses from six retrieval-augmented models on FACTORY and prior datasets. Roughly 40% of claims on FACTORY lack human-found support or are nonfactual, compared with about 10% on other benchmarks, showing that the hard prompts substantially increase factuality difficulty. Human filtering also reduces ambiguity and unanswerability. The benchmark is clearly more challenging, but failure to find support depends on search capability, link decay, and time and is not equivalent to permanent falsity.

作者对六个检索增强模型在 FACTORY 与既有数据上的回答进行人工事实评估。FACTORY 上约 40% 的 claims 无法被人类找到支持或被判非事实，而其他 benchmark 约为 10%，显示 hard prompts 能显著拉开长文事实性差距。人工筛选也减少了不可答与含糊提示。结果支持 benchmark 更困难，但“找不到支持”受搜索能力、网页消失和时间影响，不能简单等同于 claim 永久为假。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier long-form factuality benchmarks often release automatically generated questions directly or provide prompts without public human claim evidence. FACTORY combines model-based difficulty filtering with human quality control and releases evaluation-time claim labels, URLs, and evidence snippets. The central changes are prompt quality and evidence auditability rather than a new factuality formula.
既有长文事实 benchmark 通常自动生成问题后直接发布，或只提供提示而缺少公开人工 claim 证据。FACTORY 的新意是模型筛难与人工质量控制连续结合，并把评测期间的 claim 标签、URL 和证据片段一起开放。变化的核心是 prompt 质量与证据可审计性，而不是新的事实评分公式。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Evidence temporality: URLs can disappear and pages change, while Inconclusive depends on search time. Snapshots or archived links should be preserved.
  1. English and encyclopaedic origins: Seeds are largely Wikipedia-based and English, so they do not represent private professional knowledge, other languages, or breaking news.
  1. Training contamination: Public hard prompts and evidence may enter training corpora. Future evaluation needs new prompts or a hidden split.

1. 证据时效： URL 会失效、网页内容会改变，Inconclusive 也依赖搜索时间；应保存快照或归档链接。
  1. 英文与百科来源： 种子主要来自 Wikipedia 且数据为英文，不能代表专业内部知识、其他语言或实时新闻。
  1. 训练污染： 公开 hard prompts 与人工证据可能被模型训练吸收；后续评测应使用新提示或隐藏 split。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Long-form factuality evaluation: Generate retrieval-augmented long answers and report claim proportions for factual, nonfactual, inconclusive, and unverifiable content.
  1. Factuality-judge calibration: Use human labels, URLs, and snippets to test evidence matching and abstention rather than binary accuracy only.
  1. Prompt-set construction: Reuse the topic–expansion–model-difficulty-filter–human-refinement pipeline in new domains while collecting new evidence.

1. 长文事实性评测： 让模型生成检索增强长回答，按 claim 统计 factual、nonfactual、inconclusive 和不可验证比例。
  1. Factuality Judge 校准： 使用人工标签、URL 和 snippet 检查自动 Judge 的证据匹配与 abstention，而非只测二分类准确率。
  1. 提示集构建： 复用“主题—扩写—模型筛难—人工修订”流程，建立新领域提示，但需重新采集证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: FACTORY combines model-based difficulty filtering and human verification for long-tail long-form prompts with claim-level evidence annotations.
  1. Method takeaway: Wikipedia seeds, LLM expansion, difficulty filtering, human refinement, and human evidence search form the pipeline.
  1. Data takeaway: JSONL all, hard, and fact_checking splits use Factual, NonFactual, Inconclusive, and No Verifiable Fact labels.
  1. Evidence anchor: About 40% of claims from strong retrieval systems lack reliable support on FACTORY, versus about 10% on other datasets.
  1. Reuse decision: Best for long-form factuality and judge calibration; preserve evidence snapshots and control contamination.

1. 一句话定位： FACTORY 用模型筛难和人工验证构造长尾长文提示，并公开 claim 级证据标注。
  1. 方法抓手： Wikipedia 种子、LLM 扩写、难度过滤、人工修订和人工检索证据构成流程。
  1. 数据抓手： JSONL 的 all/hard/fact_checking splits；claim 标签含 Factual、NonFactual、Inconclusive 和 No Verifiable Fact。
  1. 证据锚点： SOTA 检索模型在 FACTORY 的约 40% claims 无可靠支持，其他数据约 10%。
  1. 复用决定： 适合长文 factuality 与 Judge 校准；必须保存证据快照并控制测试污染。
